The Story of Indra and the Yaksha (Divine Spirit)
The Story of King Ajatashatru and Acharya Balaki
• Experience the Profound Wisdom of the Upanishads!**
Available in Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam & Hindi
Select your preferred audio track from the settings menu!
In this enlightening episode of *Upanishad Ganga*, we delve into the profound wisdom of the Upanishads, exploring the nature of **consciousness, the life principle**, and its significance in our existence. This episode presents two captivating stories that offer deep insights into the journey of self-discovery and knowledge.
